title: Request a driving record
summary: You can order a copy of your driving record, which details your licence offences, online or in person.
intro:
A driving record is a history of offences recorded against your licence, and you're able to buy a copy of your own record if you need it.

You can order 2 types of driving record online:

Note: Certified driving records will be posted to you at the mailing address recorded with Transport for NSW – they should be received within 10 to 14 days.
who_can_apply: NSW driver licence holders who have a MyServiceNSW Account
NSW residents who have previously held a NSW driver licence
what_you_need: The PDF form: 'Access to Own Personal Records Application'
Proof of identity documents (such as passport, Photo Card)
A detailed description of the information you would like to access

how_to_steps.text: Log in, or create your MyServiceNSW Account. Enter your NSW driver licence details if your account is new or you haven't previously entered them.
Read and accept the Terms and Conditions.
Select 'Buy a certified driving record' or 'Buy an uncertified driving record'.
Check and confirm your order details.
Download and complete the Access to Own Personal Records Application – PDF.
Make sure you attach all the required documents.
Visit a service centre and submit your application with payment in person, or send to the contact details on the form.

more_info.text: Only the certified driving record can be used as evidence in legal proceedings or in a court of law. You cannot use an uncertified driving record in court or for a driver licence disqualification application.
If you require the record to be mailed to a state other than NSW, you'll need to order via post, using Access to Own Personal Records Application – PDF.
When you buy a certified driving record, you automatically get an uncertified driving record as well.
If you buy an uncertified driving record, it will be available immediately, and for 7 days.

external_links.text: Access to Own Personal Records Application – PDF

faqs.q: How long will it take to receive a certified driving record?
faqs.a: Certified driving records will be posted to the mailing address recorded with Transport for NSW and should be received within 10 to 14 days.

faqs.q: Who is eligible to order a driving record?
faqs.a: NSW driver licence holders who have a MyServiceNSW Account, or NSW residents who previously held a NSW driver licence.

faqs.q: What do I need if I cannot order online?
faqs.a: If you are unable to order online, you will need to visit a service centre and submit your application with payment in person, or send it to the contact details on the form.
